name: context-band
description: A band above the prompt showing the session's context usage, plan quota or cost

warningThreshold.title: Warning colour at
warningThreshold.description: Percent where colours turn to warning (1-100)

errorThreshold.title: Error colour at
errorThreshold.description: Percent where colours turn to error (1-100)

refreshSeconds.title: Fallback refresh (s)
refreshSeconds.description: Fallback redraw interval in seconds; turn ends update it at once

showEffort.title: Show model & effort
showEffort.description: Show the model name and its effort scale on the band

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show the session cost when no plan quota is reported

showResetIn.title: Show plan reset time
showResetIn.description: Show when the nearest plan window resets
